Quon Sang Lung Laundry Shop data contains 3D scans of the entire building prior to be being demolished due to safety concerns. Sixteen (16) scans were captured using a scanner type. Scan data is saved in .las format using Faro Scene v. 7.0 and Cloud Compare v.2.9.1.
